components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 14px 20px; list-style: none; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E3E6EB; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5F6B7A; } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: 1; } .ds-step:last-child { flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-step:not(:last-child)::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 2px; margin: 0 16px; background: #E3E6EB; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-step.ds-line-done::after { background: #2F5DE1; } .ds-dot { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #C9CFD8; background: #FFFFFF; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-done .ds-dot { border-color: #2F5DE1; color: #2F5DE1; } .ds-current .ds-dot { border-color: #2F5DE1; background: #2F5DE1; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-current .ds-label { color: #1B1F24; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
PocketPrune is a calm, light working tool. A cool off-white page holds white cards with thin grey borders, and one blue does all the pointing: the step you are on, the thing you picked, the button that moves you forward. Everything else is grey text on white. Every job screen sits under a five-step pipeline rail (Model, Device, Preflight, Run, Results), so you always know where you are in the compression job. It is not a sidebar dashboard.

The tokens live in one file, `frontend/src/theme/theme.js`, which a future React Native app copies unchanged. `applyTheme.js` turns them into CSS variables (`--color-*`, `--font-*`, `--space-*`, `--radius-*`). That is why the system is deliberately plain: no blur, no complex gradients, no information shown only on hover, minimal motion. Anything that would not port to a phone app does not belong here. Base palette, type sizes, spacing and radii are fixed by CLAUDE.md §9; the extra shades exist only to pass contrast.

The one picture with personality is the compression ladder: grey baseline bar for F16, blue bars for the quantized levels, so you can see how much each level shrinks a model.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (blue), used for current step, selection and the primary action only.
Flat white cards on a cool grey page; 1px borders do the separating.
Four type sizes (13/15/18/24), two weights (400/600), Inter only.
Persistent pipeline rail plus a 340px "Your job" summary.
Built to port: everything is a token, stacked cards, no hover-only content.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "here, chosen, or go". Never use it for decoration, headings or big fills.

rules.name: The Green Means Done Rule
rules.body: Green appears only for success (completed, quick-to-demo, passed checks). It is never a second accent.

rules.name: The Soft-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every pale `*-soft` background is paired with its dark `*-text` shade, never with the bright status colour.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 600. Emphasis is 600; muted is colour, not a lighter weight.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Sizes, counts and inputs use tabular figures (`.num`, inputs) so columns of MB values align.

rules.name: The Always Know Where You Are Rule
rules.body: Every job screen shows the pipeline rail and the job summary. The next-step button is always reachable, on phones as a fixed bottom bar.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. No blur, no large shadows, no glass, no gradients. These do not port to the app.

rules.name: The Honest Tick Rule
rules.body: A tick, a blue connector or a green badge is only shown for something that is actually true.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Ladders that sit side by side use one scale, or the comparison lies.

dos: **Do** take every colour, size, space and radius from `theme.js` through its CSS variables; never hard-code a hex in a component.
**Do** keep blue for the current step, the selection and the single primary action.
**Do** pair every `*-soft` background with its `*-text` colour.
**Do** put the compression ladder wherever a model's sizes are shown, F16 grey, quantized blue, "≈" when estimated.
**Do** make every grid collapse to one column under 720px and keep the next-step button reachable as a fixed bottom bar under 960px.
**Do** keep motion to short ease-outs on bar widths and button colours, and respect reduced motion.
**Do** use lucide line icons at 18px in buttons and nav, always next to a text label or an aria-label.
donts: **Don't** use blur, glass, complex gradients or large shadows; they do not port to React Native.
**Don't** put information only in a hover state or tooltip; phones have no hover.
**Don't** add a third font weight, a second font family, or new type sizes.
**Don't** use green or blue as decoration; they carry meaning (done, here/go).
**Don't** mark a step done, or colour its connector blue, before it is really reached.
**Don't** replace the pipeline rail with a sidebar dashboard layout.
